title: DIRECTION v1 brief response
description: internal/server/direction.BriefResponse (RFC 0001 section 12): the four fixed sections in priority order (precepts, intents, entities, questions), each included whole or dropped whole, plus the estimator name every caller needs to interpret token_budget correctly.

budget_estimator.description: Names the unit governing packing, e.g. "words" -- never left for a caller to guess.

items.description: internal/server/direction.BriefSectionWire. omitted > 0 implies items is empty, and vice versa -- a section is included whole or dropped whole, never truncated.
